external_entities.name: insurance partner
external_entities.description: One of three insurance partners that delivers daily claim extracts.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Three insurance partners drop a daily extract for us.
external_entities.notes: Each partner has a static key issued during onboarding; the keys have not changed since.

external_entities.name: analyst
external_entities.description: An analyst who queries the warehouse directly.
external_entities.notes: Analysts authenticate with SSO and have a dataset-wide grant; member-identifying columns have not been split out.

processes.name: Airflow scheduler
processes.description: A scheduler that lists and reads files from the landing bucket and triggers Spark transform jobs.
processes.source_excerpt: An Airflow scheduler running in the landing network wakes up at 02:00, lists the bucket, and reads whatever is there.
processes.notes: It does not check that a file came from the partner whose folder it landed in. It keeps connection strings and partner keys in its metadata database.

processes.name: Spark transform job
processes.description: A transform job that normalizes claim records and loads them into BigQuery.
processes.source_excerpt: For each file the scheduler triggers a Spark transform job in the warehouse network. The transform normalizes the records and loads them into BigQuery.
processes.notes: Nothing validates the row contents beyond the schema.

data_stores.name: landing bucket
data_stores.description: A bucket receiving daily claim extracts from insurance partners.
data_stores.source_excerpt: They push files into a landing bucket over SFTP.
data_stores.notes: The source says: "I don't know how the landing bucket is encrypted ... Both are on defaults as far as I know."

data_stores.name: Airflow metadata database
data_stores.description: The metadata database holding Airflow connection strings and partner keys.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Airflow keeps its connection strings and the partner keys in its own metadata database.
data_stores.notes: The source says: "I don't know ... whether the Airflow metadata database is encrypted at rest. Both are on defaults as far as I know."

data_stores.name: BigQuery
data_stores.description: The warehouse holding normalized claim records.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The transform normalizes the records and loads them into BigQuery.

data_flows.name: push extracts
data_flows.description: An insurance partner pushes a daily claim extract into the landing bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: They push files into a landing bucket over SFTP.
data_flows.data_description: Claim records with member names and dates of birth

data_flows.name: read files
data_flows.description: The Airflow scheduler lists and reads files from the landing bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: An Airflow scheduler running in the landing network wakes up at 02:00, lists the bucket, and reads whatever is there.
data_flows.notes: The scheduler does not check that a file came from the partner whose folder it landed in.

data_flows.name: store credentials
data_flows.description: The Airflow scheduler keeps connection strings and partner keys in its metadata database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Airflow keeps its connection strings and the partner keys in its own metadata database.

data_flows.name: trigger transform
data_flows.description: The Airflow scheduler triggers a Spark transform job for each file.
data_flows.source_excerpt: For each file the scheduler triggers a Spark transform job in the warehouse network.

data_flows.name: load records
data_flows.description: The Spark transform job loads normalized claim records into BigQuery.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The transform normalizes the records and loads them into BigQuery.

data_flows.name: query warehouse
data_flows.description: An analyst queries the warehouse directly.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Analysts query the warehouse directly. They are on the warehouse network and authenticate with SSO, but the grant is dataset-wide — we have not split member-identifying columns out.
data_flows.notes: The grant is dataset-wide and member-identifying columns have not been split out.

trust_boundaries.name: landing network
trust_boundaries.description: The network in which the Airflow scheduler runs.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: An Airflow scheduler running in the landing network

trust_boundaries.name: warehouse network
trust_boundaries.description: The network in which the Spark transform job runs and analysts are located.

assumptions.assumption: The Airflow scheduler presents a non-web batch interface.
assumptions.basis: It is described as a scheduler that wakes at a scheduled time, lists a bucket, reads files, and triggers jobs.

assumptions.assumption: The Spark transform job presents a non-web batch interface.
assumptions.basis: It is described as a transform job triggered for each file.

assumptions.assumption: The claim extracts in the landing bucket are confidential.
assumptions.basis: The bucket contains claim records with member names and dates of birth.

assumptions.assumption: The Airflow metadata database is confidential.
assumptions.basis: It contains connection strings and partner keys.
BigQuery stores normalized claim records containing member names and dates of birth.

assumptions.assumption: SFTP provides encryption in transit intrinsically.
assumptions.basis: The flow is explicitly described as using SFTP; SFTP encryption is intrinsic.
